package integration

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	tokenclient "example.com/formunionit/gen/http/token/client"
	tokenserver "example.com/formunionit/gen/http/token/server"
	token "example.com/formunionit/gen/token"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	form "github.com/go-playground/form/v4"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type authCodeForm struct {
	ClientID    string `form:"client_id"`
	Code        string `form:"code"`
	RedirectURI string `form:"redirect_uri"`
}

// These functions prototype the typed union boundary, not a replacement runtime.
// The library owns branch field traversal; the adapter owns the discriminator.
func encodeGrant(p *token.Grant) (url.Values, error) {
	if err := p.Grant.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var body any
	if v, ok := p.Grant.AsAuthorizationCode(); ok {
		body = authCodeForm{v.ClientID, v.Code, v.RedirectURI}
	} else {
		body = struct{}{}
	}
	values, err := form.NewEncoder().Encode(body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	values.Set("grant_type", string(p.Grant.Kind()))
	return values, nil
}

func decodeGrant(values url.Values) (*token.Grant, error) {
	var branch token.Grant2
	switch values.Get("grant_type") {
	case "authorization_code":
		var body authCodeForm
		if err := form.NewDecoder().Decode(&body, values); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		branch = token.NewGrant2AuthorizationCode(&token.AuthorizationCodeGrant{
			ClientID: body.ClientID, Code: body.Code, RedirectURI: body.RedirectURI,
		})
	case "refresh_token":
		branch = token.NewGrant2RefreshToken(&token.RefreshTokenGrant{})
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid grant_type %q", values.Get("grant_type"))
	}
	return &token.Grant{Grant: &branch}, nil
}

func TestLibraryUnionAdapterInteroperability(t *testing.T) {
	auth := token.NewGrant2AuthorizationCode(&token.AuthorizationCodeGrant{
		ClientID: "client-123", Code: "code-123", RedirectURI: "https://client.example/callback",
	})
	refresh := token.NewGrant2RefreshToken(&token.RefreshTokenGrant{})
	for _, branch := range []*token.Grant2{&auth, &refresh} {
		t.Run(string(branch.Kind()), func(t *testing.T) {
			input := &token.Grant{Grant: branch}
			// Library + typed adapter -> unchanged generated server decoder.
			values, err := encodeGrant(input)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/token", strings.NewReader(values.Encode()))
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
			decode := tokenserver.DecodeExchangeRequest(loomhttp.NewMuxer(), loomhttp.RequestDecoder)
			got, err := decode(req)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, input, got)
			// Unchanged generated client encoder -> library + typed adapter.
			request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/token", nil)
			encode := tokenclient.EncodeExchangeRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder)
			require.NoError(t, encode(request, input))
			require.NoError(t, request.ParseForm())
			result, err := decodeGrant(request.PostForm)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, input, result)
			require.Equal(t, values, request.PostForm)
		})
	}
}
